bench.label: Bench
bench.description: Park bench along X: wooden seat slats and an optional reclined backrest on cast-iron side frames (two, or three on long benches). The seat faces +Z. Pivot at the centre of the base. Pieces: bench_slats (wood), bench_frames (metal_dark). Every piece is closed.

seed.desc: random seed of the slat tint

bollard.label: Bollard
bollard.description: Street bollard: a round post with a domed top or a square post with a pyramid cap, an optional reflective band and a base ring. Pivot at the centre of the base. Pieces: bollard_body (metal_dark), bollard_band (reflective). Every piece is closed.

cable.label: Cable
cable.description: Hanging cable between two points: a catenary that sags by `sag` below the straight line at mid-span, swept as a tube, with optional wooden poles (with a cross arm and insulators) standing on y = 0 under the ends. With the default end points the pivot is the foot of the first pole. Pieces: cable (rubber), cable_poles (wood_dark), cable_insulators (ceramic). Every piece is closed.

sag.desc: drop below the straight line at mid-span (m)

fence.label: Fence
fence.description: Fence along a curve (input 0; without one, a straight run of `run_length` along +X from the origin) in three styles: picket (white pointed pickets on two rails), plank (horizontal boards) and rail (three ranch rails). Posts at even spacing including both ends. Sits on the curve (pivot = the curve). Pieces: fence_posts, fence_infill (paint_white, wood or wood_dark by style).

run_length.desc: run length along +X when no curve is connected (m)

seed.desc: random seed of the board tint

kit.label: Street kit
kit.description: TopoTopo's street kit, its 7 outputs side by side at their defaults. The package's default output and its preview, from bench to sign_post along +X, 1 m apart.

lamp_post.label: Lamp post
lamp_post.description: Street lamp: a tapered pole on a flared base with 1–4 curved arms carrying shades and glowing glass (arms 0 = a lantern on top of the pole). The first arm points along +X. Pivot at the centre of the base. Pieces: lamp_pole, lamp_arms, lamp_heads (metal_dark), lamp_glass (lamp_glass, emissive). Every piece is closed.

arms.desc: number of arms (0 = lantern on top)

road_strip.label: Road
road_strip.description: Road along a curve (input 0; without one, a gentle 24 m S-curve along X): an asphalt ribbon of `width` centred on the curve with solid white edge lines, dashed lane lines between `lanes` lanes, and kerbs with sidewalks on both sides. Follows the curve's height (drape the curve on a terrain first). Pivot = the curve. Pieces: road_surface (asphalt), road_markings (road_paint), road_kerbs (concrete), road_sidewalks (paving).

lanes.desc: number of lanes (dashed lines between them)

edge_lines.desc: solid lines 0.2 m inside both edges

dash_length.desc: length of the lane dashes (gaps are as long) (m)

kerb_height.desc: kerb height above the asphalt (m); 0 = no kerbs or sidewalks

sidewalk_width.desc: sidewalk width behind each kerb (m); 0 = none

sign_post.label: Street sign
sign_post.description: Street name sign: a post with a ball cap and a green blade (two crossed blades for a corner) carrying raised white lettering on both faces, scaled to fit. The first blade faces ±Z. Pivot at the centre of the base. Pieces: sign_post (galvanized), sign_panel (sign_green), sign_text (sign_white). Every piece is closed.

cross_text.desc: lettering on the second blade (empty = one blade)

default.description: TopoTopo's street kit, its 7 outputs side by side at their defaults. The package's default output and its preview, from bench to sign_post along +X, 1 m apart.
